title: Prayer and the Spirit
definition: Prayer and the Spirit teaches that the Holy Spirit helps believers pray according to God's will, even in weakness.
summary: The Spirit strengthens prayer, intercedes for believers, and draws God's children into deeper dependence on the Father.
christFocus: Through Christ, believers have access to the Father by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit strengthens prayer, intercedes for believers, and draws God's children into deeper dependence on the Father.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
